item.title: Blackhawks', Sharks' rebuilds starting to diverge as Sharks pick up pace, Hawks stay patient
item.description: <p>For several years, the front offices of the <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/blackhawks" target="_blank" >Blackhawks</a> and Sharks have moved in relative lockstep.</p><p>Both franchises opted for scorched-earth rebuilds, tore down their rosters, endured some horrendous seasons to get top draft picks, selected the two best young players in the NHL and accumulated the two best prospect pools around them.</p><p>This season, however, the first signs of divergence have emerged.

item.title: Cider lovers and the cider curious are brought together for the annual Cider Summit
item.description: <p>The 12th annual cider summit festival brought a sweet, sharp, and fizzy energy to Navy Pier on Saturday.</p><p>The Cider Summit invited more than three dozen cider producers and about 125 cider products for cider enthusiasts and the cider curious to enjoy. Attendees were given 16 tickets to taste the cider products. item.title: 2 teens shot, wounded on CTA bus in Humboldt Park
item.description: <p>Two teens were hospitalized Saturday after being shot in a scuffle on a CTA bus in Humboldt Park.</p><p>A group of males was fighting about 3:20 p.m. on a bus in the 4000 block of West Chicago Avenue when a gun went off, Chicago police said.</p><p>A 15-year-old boy suffered a gunshot wound to the groin and buttocks, and an 18-year-old man was shot in the leg, police said.</p><p>The boy was taken to Stroger Hospital and the man to Mount Sinai Hospital. item.title: With young core having a season under its belt, White Sox feel they can 'shake some things up this year’
item.description: <p>White Sox catcher Kyle Teel has been devouring any food in sight this offseason.</p><p>‘‘I’m eating everything, dude,’’ Teel said Friday at SoxFest Live. ‘‘Literally everything. It doesn’t matter what it is.’’</p><p>Bulking up during the offseason was one of Teel’s goals. He has added 20 pounds of muscle by being dedicated in the weight room and increasing his calorie intake. He hopes that added strength will help him hold up over a 162-game season and unlock multiple areas of his game.</p><p
